# Helvety

> Main Helvety website for products, legal information, and links to all Helvety apps. Engineered, Designed & Made in Switzerland. Software products. Private, simple, clean.

## Canonical URLs
- [Home](https://helvety.com): Main landing page
- [Privacy Policy](https://helvety.com/privacy): Current privacy policy
- [Terms of Service](https://helvety.com/terms): Terms governing service use
- [Impressum](https://helvety.com/impressum): Legal company information

## Crawling And Indexing
- Public pages are intended to be indexable by search and AI crawlers.
- Private app routes are not intended as search index targets and use noindex and auth-gated controls.

## Helvety Ecosystem
- [Helvety Store](https://helvety.com/store): Product catalog, app details, and installable packages (for example SharePoint SPFx and browser extensions)
- [Helvety SPO Explorer](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-spo-explorer): SharePoint Framework package for SharePoint site navigation
- [Power Automate Browser Extension](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-power-automate-force-v3-false): Browser extension for classic Power Automate editor URL behavior
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/pdf): Browser-based PDF toolkit for supported operations
- [Helvety Image Upscaler](https://helvety.com/image-upscaler): Browser-based image upscaler with local-only processing
- [Helvety Auth](https://helvety.com/auth): Authentication service
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/contacts): Contact management app
- [Helvety Notes](https://helvety.com/notes): Notes management app
- [Helvety Tasks](https://helvety.com/tasks): Task management app

## Source
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/CasparRubin/helvety): Open-source monorepo (MIT)
